La Grange Park is a village in Cook County, Illinois, United States. Per the 2020 census, the population was 13,475.


== Geography ==
La Grange Park is located at 41°49′47″N 87°52′9″W (41.829831, -87.869233).According to the 2010 census, La Grange Park has a total area of 2.23 square miles (5.78 km2), all land.
